question: For which discovery in 1932 was James Chadwick best known?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neutron**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• James Chadwick i**s best known for discovering the neutron in 1932.**
 
• Neutrons are present in the nucleus of all atoms, except hydrogen.
 
• In general, a neutron is represented as ‘n’.
 
• The mass of a neutron is 1.6750 x 10-27 kg.
 
• The mass of an atom is therefore given by the sum of the masses of protons and neutrons present in the nucleus.
 
• Neutrons and protons are found in the nucleus of an atom.
 
• Neutrons were discovered by James Chadwick.
